name: HoldPitch
_intent: Pitcher's ready stance before the wind-up, feet planted square to the lane exactly as the Throw starts, shoulders turned a little side-on (left shoulder to the lane), head on the target; the food (r 0.9) sits ON the right hand's end face (palm up) by the right shoulder, elbow bent and down; the left arm hangs loose in front. Breathing, a slow weight shift and two small toss-ready pumps of the hand (the food never leaves the hand).
_reference: baseball / cricket ready stance before the wind-up; 2.0 s loop, pumps at frames 16 and 46
